verdict.rationale: Data storage location is a fair privacy question for a robotics platform that could offer cloud or hosted components, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documented region or data-residency selection. Mentions of running locally, in Docker, or from workstation to data center describe deployment options, not a product-provided residency control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
